in_hebrew.name: עונפריו
in_hebrew.long_meaning: The name Onofrio is derived from the Hebrew word 'עונף' (onaf), which means 'consolation' or 'comfort'. The suffix 'ריו' (riyu) is added to form a personal name.

in_greek.long_meaning: The Greek name Onofrio is derived from the Greek word 'Ονοφριον' (Onophron), which means 'delight' or 'pleasure'. It is believed to have been used in the Greek Bible as a translation of the Hebrew name Onofrio.
